review: Reviewed Wren's round-204 request (Prepare meadow roots for a meal: learn a feasible hands-on method to prepare owned edible meadow roots, known nutrition 14 and toxicity 0, into a different meal with actual ingredient use and observable results, outdoors on ordinary soil in summer, with no cooking equipment, heat source or cooking skill, effects unknown, no assumed improvement and no wellbeing for requesting or learning) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 2): a general 'Hand-break food' operation, the smallest equipment-free precursor of food preparation, parameterized by mode (trial, prepare, inspect, cancel), owned input stack id, whole-unit quantity and optional work id, with trial and preparation sharing one mechanism; whether roots yield to hand force must be resolved by an explicit deterministic hand-workability rule using material resistance, represented geometry and available hand force, never inferred from name or edibility; no tools, heat, water, vessel or work surface; trial one unit for one round and 1 energy, prepare 1 round and 1 energy per unit with units kept individually, inspect one round and 0.2 energy reporting only observable form, quantity, stage and deterioration, cancel without work energy; coarse pieces are the same food quantity in a changed form with the same owner, source, harvest age, decay, nutrition and toxicity; pauses before any charge, resume by work id, cancellation and death release unworked units once, no refunds, no replacement of lost or spoiled units, no new reward. The specification is self-consistent and every part has a basis in the world, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented hand-break-food@1 in scope long-ex16 (new file packages/world-core/src/long-hand-break-food.ts, registered at the end of V7_PACKAGES; learning 2 with learningEnergy 0.2, so study is two individually completed rounds at 0.2 energy; the ability serializes to 2,929 code units, within the 3,500 limit). Inputs are named only by the exact id of an owned, unreserved, untreated, unspoiled food item whose resource the person's own record shows as edible (references are deliberately empty so the shared resolver cannot substitute a resource name; 'root' is refused); trial takes exactly one whole unit, prepare 1-10 whole units of that item. Validation (mastery, exact id, own food record, untreated and unprocessed, not spoiled, enough whole units, at least 1 energy, no unfinished work of this person) precedes any reservation, so refusals spend nothing. Both modes create one collective-work record (stable work id) and reserve every selected unit at once through workReserve as separate 1-unit escrow stacks that stay carried, owned, counted as load and ageing (hand-break-started); each paid round (workPay, 1 energy) applies bounded two-hand bending force once to the next held unit (hand-force-applied) and settles it atomically: a fractured unit becomes a new owned lot of the same resource, quantity, origin, harvest time and decay with processing.handBreak {form coarse-pieces, pieces 2, source item, escrow unit, work id, actor, tick, visual} (food-fractured); a deformed unit becomes such a lot with form deformed and 1 piece (food-deformed); a resisted unit is released unchanged as the same whole stack with no processing record (hand-break-resisted, 'nothing was prepared'). Prepare continues each round as the bound action or by prepare with workId; after the last unit hand-break-completed reports fractured, deformed and resisted counts. An unworked round pauses the work in the environment hook and too little energy pauses before payment (hand-break-paused, no charge); resuming pays only the next unit after rechecking the reserved units and energy (hand-break-resumed). Cancel (no energy, optional workId) releases unworked units once, unchanged, and leaves worked lots as they are (hand-break-cancelled); a reserved unit that spoils is recorded once as lost and never replaced (an all-lost work stops, hand-break-stopped); death releases unworked units on the ground at the death position once (hand-break-stopped) and worked lots follow the existing possession rule. Inspect (workId of one's own work, or inputStackId of one's own food item; 1 round, 0.2 energy) reports form, pieces, quantity, the already displayed decay value, reservation and work stage, selected, remaining, paid energy, outputs and lost units as an unverified personal record (hand-break-inspected). Each worked unit writes a verified personal record keyed hand-break-food:<resource>:whole-untreated:<outcome> holding only the observed outcome, form, pieces and a short observation, so the first observation of a response emits information-confirmed bound to this interface (the probe-bound grounded-understanding rule does not apply) and repeated or equivalent trials confirm nothing new. hand-break-completed is the practice evidence but never carries a qualified flag, so no practice milestone, and the package adds no satisfaction, pleasure, comfort, mastery, permission or reward. Eating stays the unchanged eat path: lots keep resource root and no food method, so a coarse-piece lot gives exactly the nutrition (14 per unit before existing deterioration), toxicity, meal method ('unprocessed'), experience and wellbeing of a whole root of the same age (tested). Events carry actor, work, input and output ids, visible quantity, form, position, progress and outcome and reusable food-lot visual metadata (component food, form, pieces, palette, quantity, decay); no world object is created, so visualComponents is empty and no drawing was added; coarse pieces appear only on lots that actually fractured. Modeling assumptions (declared, not measured): the rule hand-break@1 uses only existing engine values, openMaterial strength = hardness/10 and flexibility = flexibility/10; the only represented geometry of a food unit is its whole-unit identity and unit mass, so units are taken as geometrically similar and the force needed to break one scales with its cross-section, strength x mass^(2/3), with mass units read as kilograms; the available bounded bare-hand force is declared as 0.1 on that scale, the value that just breaks a 1 kg unit of the weakest rigid tissue (hardness 1); tissue with strength 0 has no rigid section and squashes out of shape; tissue at or above flexibility 0.2 (ex16 branch-screen@1's open-weave value, deflection of about one thickness) bends without separating; otherwise a unit at or below the hand force snaps and above it resists; the comparison uses cubes so only exact multiplication is involved. For meadow roots (hardness 1, flexibility 0, mass 0.4) the scaled resistance is about 0.054, below 0.1, and the tissue is inflexible, so a root snaps; the same rule gives deformation for berries, plums, mushrooms, red fungi and fish (hardness 0), fracture for apples (0.045) and marsh tubers (0.071) and resistance for acorns (0.119), fibrous fern roots (0.109), hazelnuts (0.137) and walnuts (0.224), so not every edible material succeeds. One bounded snap separates a unit once into two coarse pieces; the piece count is visible metadata of one lot, not several nutrition-bearing units. Nothing detaches in a snap or deformation, so there is no waste portion and the whole quantity, mass and nutritional share stay in the lot. Decay does not change the response because no tissue-softening rule exists, and fracture does not change spoilage: ex10's opening damage belongs to food opened and spread thin in the food water representation and is not applied, so existing ageing continues unchanged, also during pauses, with no preservation, freshness reset or faster spoilage. Hands and grip are not represented: any living person who studied counts as having usable hands, and reserved units stay carried by their owner, so reach cannot be lost. Eligibility requires the person's own record of the food as edible so the operation reveals no hidden edibility; toxicity is not required to be 0 and is kept unchanged. Food with any treatment or processing record, including an earlier hand-break, combined lots and water-composition food, is refused because re-breaking pieces and working treated food have no law here; broken and deformed lots therefore also stay refused by existing operations that require unprocessed food, such as cultivate-plants propagules, while a resisted unit is ordinary whole food again. Hidden values (strength, flexibility, the force and bending constants, lifetime) never appear in events or records. At most 10 units per preparation. Reuse: collective-work.ts (escrow, paid work, stop), open-physical.ts openMaterial, open-foundation.ts openRemember, collective-food-profile.ts, forest-climate.ts forestEvent and the unchanged eat path and meal experience; the escrowed food-work, pause, resume, cancel and death pattern of ex15 food-preparation@1 and the verified material-response record of ex16 hand-weave-fiber-mat@1, re-implemented in a new module. ex15 food-preparation@1 (portioning and combining into one stack with component lots) and ex14 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 (paired ground exposure) are different transformations, so they were not parameterized; no earlier package or long-plant-cultivation.ts changed and continuous.ts changed only by the registration, so ex7-ex15 behavior and ability text stay byte-identical. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex16-hand-break-food.test.ts) cover scope, two study rounds at 0.2 energy, the size limit, excluded vocabulary, a one-round 1-energy root trial producing one coarse-piece lot with the same origin, age and quantity, conservation and load, no hidden values, a single information confirmation, eating equal to a whole root, three-unit preparation for 3 rounds and 3 energy with separate lots, pause without charge, ageing while paused, resume by work id, cancel, cost-free refusals (resource name, missing or ground item, quantity, energy, broken lot, unknown food, unfinished work), a berry deforming and a hazelnut resisting, inspection, personal-only work, a spoiled reserved unit not replaced and death.
